subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB3325
title: Provides that taxing districts within counties with high averaged annual ratios of tourists to residents may expend a certain percentage of net transient lodging taxes for essential services that benefit both residents and tourists.
headline: HB 3325 did not pass

claims.text: HB 3325 was introduced in the House on January 21, 2025.
